digest.component_or_area: CI/CD pytest configuration and timeout budgeting
propositions: CLI --timeout and --timeout-method flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) permanently shadow ini-level budget changes in patchsets because workflow files execute from trusted main while ini travels with the patchset

The pytest-timeout precedence order (CLI > env > ini) prevents a patchset's own Verified run from exercising an ini-level hang-budget change because the trusted-main workflow supplies the CLI flags that override it

Removing --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread CLI flags from both shared-tier lanes and single-sourcing the budget to [tool.pytest.ini_options] (already carrying identical values: timeout=300, timeout_method=thread) maintains effective budget while allowing patchset budget changes to be tested by their own Verified run

The conftest-floor mechanism (branch preserve/timeout-floor-hardening, commit b38bf9a4748) was rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config._env_timeout read-only at session start with no supported hook point and no OSS precedent

All other eleven pytest CI lanes (external-integration, optionality, eval-discipline, test.yml, structured-output-baseline) retain their own calibrated CLI --timeout flags because they drive live services, clean-venv installs, eval sweeps, or run outside the repo rootdir where the ini is not in play
